label: John 10:1
text: “Most certainly, I tell you, one who doesn’t enter by the door into the sheep fold, but climbs up some other way, the same is a thief and a robber.

label: John 10:2
text: But one who enters in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.

label: John 10:3
text: The gatekeeper opens the gate for him, and the sheep listen to his voice. He calls his own sheep by name, and leads them out.

label: John 10:4
text: Whenever he brings out his own sheep, he goes before them, and the sheep follow him, for they know his voice.

label: John 10:5
text: They will by no means follow a stranger, but will flee from him; for they don’t know the voice of strangers.”

label: John 10:6
text: Jesus spoke this parable to them, but they didn’t understand what he was telling them.

label: John 10:7
text:
Jesus therefore said to them again,
“Most certainly, I tell you, I am the sheep’s door.

variants.reading: ο ποιμην ('the shepherd') for 'the door' (η θυρα)
variants.note: Wikipedia, Textual variants in the Gospel of John (John 10:7): 'η θυρα (door) - majority; ο ποιμην (shepherd) - P75 cop sa cop ac'. The WEB prints the majority 'door' reading.

label: John 10:8
text: All who came before me are thieves and robbers, but the sheep didn’t listen to them.

label: John 10:9
text: I am the door. If anyone enters in by me, he will be saved, and will go in and go out, and will find pasture.

label: John 10:10
text: The thief only comes to steal, kill, and destroy. I came that they may have life, and may have it abundantly.

label: John 10:11
text:
I am the good shepherd.
The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.

label: John 10:12
text: He who is a hired hand, and not a shepherd, who doesn’t own the sheep, sees the wolf coming, leaves the sheep, and flees. The wolf snatches the sheep, and scatters them.

label: John 10:13
text: The hired hand flees because he is a hired hand, and doesn’t care for the sheep.

label: John 10:14
text: I am the good shepherd. I know my own, and I’m known by my own;

label: John 10:15
text: even as the Father knows me, and I know the Father. I lay down my life for the sheep.

label: John 10:16
text:
I have other sheep, which are not of this fold.
I must bring them also, and they will hear my voice. They will become one flock with one shepherd.

label: John 10:17
text:
Therefore the Father loves me, because I lay down my life,

that I may take it again.

label: John 10:18
text: No one takes it away from me, but I lay it down by myself. I have power to lay it down, and I have power to take it again. I received this commandment from my Father.”

label: John 10:19
text: Therefore a division arose again among the Jews because of these words.

label: John 10:20
text: Many of them said, “He has a demon, and is insane! Why do you listen to him?”

label: John 10:21
text: Others said, “These are not the sayings of one possessed by a demon. It isn’t possible for a demon to open the eyes of the blind, is it?”

label: John 10:22
text: It was the Feast of the Dedication at Jerusalem.

label: John 10:23
text: It was winter, and Jesus was walking in the temple, in Solomon’s porch.

label: John 10:24
text: The Jews therefore came around him and said to him, “How long will you hold us in suspense? If you are the Christ, tell us plainly.”

label: John 10:25
text:
Jesus answered them,
“I told you, and you don’t believe. The works that I do in my Father’s name, these testify about me.

label: John 10:26
text: But you don’t believe, because you are not of my sheep, as I told you.

label: John 10:27
text: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me.

label: John 10:28
text: I give eternal life to them. They will never perish, and no one will snatch them out of my hand.

label: John 10:29
text: My Father, who has given them to me, is greater than all. No one is able to snatch them out of my Father’s hand.

label: John 10:30
text: I and the Father are one.”

label: John 10:31
text: Therefore Jews took up stones again to stone him.

label: John 10:32
text:
Jesus answered them,
“I have shown you many good works from my Father. For which of those works do you stone me?”

label: John 10:33
text: The Jews answered him, “We don’t stone you for a good work, but for blasphemy: because you, being a man, make yourself God.”

label: John 10:34
text:
Jesus answered them,
“Isn’t it written in your law, ‘I said, you are gods?’

label: John 10:35
text: If he called them gods, to whom the word of God came (and the Scripture can’t be broken),

label: John 10:36
text: do you say of him whom the Father sanctified and sent into the world, ‘You blaspheme,’ because I said, ‘I am the Son of God?’

label: John 10:37
text: If I don’t do the works of my Father, don’t believe me.

label: John 10:38
text: But if I do them, though you don’t believe me, believe the works; that you may know and believe that the Father is in me, and I in the Father.”

label: John 10:39
text: They sought again to seize him, and he went out of their hand.

label: John 10:40
text: He went away again beyond the Jordan into the place where John was baptizing at first, and there he stayed.

label: John 10:41
text: Many came to him. They said, “John indeed did no sign, but everything that John said about this man is true.”

label: John 10:42
text: Many believed in him there.

label: Sheep were kept in a sheepfold entered through a door
statement: Sheep were kept in a sheepfold, and the shepherd of the sheep entered by the door into the fold, while thieves and robbers climbed in another way.

label: The sheep knew and followed the shepherd's voice, not a stranger's
statement: The gatekeeper opened the gate to the shepherd; the sheep heard his voice, he called his own sheep by name and led them out, and the sheep followed him because they knew his voice; a stranger they would by no means follow.

label: The Feast of the Dedication was kept at Jerusalem
statement: It was the Feast of the Dedication (Hanukkah, ta enkainia) at Jerusalem - the eight-day festival of the temple's rededication, kept annually from 25 Kislev.

label: It was winter at the Feast of the Dedication
statement: It was winter when the Feast of the Dedication came; the festival begins 25 Kislev, which falls in the November-December part of the year.

label: Jesus was walking in the temple in Solomon's porch
statement: Jesus was walking in the temple, in Solomon's porch - the temple colonnade that tradition ascribed to Solomon.

label: The Jews took up stones again to stone him
statement: The Jews took up stones again to stone Jesus after he said 'I and the Father are one' (10:30); 'again' recalls the stone-taking of John 8:59.

label: Blasphemy was the charge for which stoning was invoked
statement: The Jews said they did not stone him for a good work but for blasphemy, because he, being a man, made himself God; stoning was the punishment they invoked for blasphemy.

label: Psalm 82:6 quoted from the law ('I said, you are gods')
statement: Jesus answered from 'your law': 'I said, you are gods' - Psalm 82:6, cited as Scripture that cannot be broken (10:35).

label: They sought again to seize him, and he went out of their hand
statement: They sought again to seize him after the discourse, and he went out of their hand.

label: Jesus went away again beyond the Jordan, where John was baptizing at first
statement: Jesus went away again beyond the Jordan into the place where John was baptizing at first, and stayed there; many came to him, saying everything John said of him was true, and many believed (10:41-42).

label: Wikipedia: Pen (enclosure) (ancient dry stone sheepfolds)
title: Pen (enclosure)
excerpt: In British English, a sheep pen is also called a folding , sheepfold or sheepcote . Modern shepherds more commonly use terms such as closing or confinement pen for small sheep pens. Most structures today referred to as sheepfolds are ancient dry stone semicircles.
